unreachableItemsOnMobile.text: Scroll through the five pivotal turning points that transformed a Malay Peninsula fishing village into a sovereign republic by necessity.
With zero natural resources and not even enough fresh water in 1965, Singapore turned human capital and relentless pragmatism into a rising global metropolis.
Rather than forcing assimilation, Singapore protects each community's heritage while designing everyday spaces where all backgrounds meet as neighbors.
